## Domain analysis and decisions

### Business and organizational constraints (`constraints`)

Describe geography, business units, capability, funding, and existing authority.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Current actors and interfaces (`stakeholders`)

Identify current decision makers, handoffs, conflicts, and capability gaps.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Operating-model options (`model_options`)

Compare centralized, decentralized, network, hybrid, and federated models on accountability and cost.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Target and transition model (`selected_model`)

Record choice rationale, interim state, shared services, and local responsibilities.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Authority charter and roles (`role_charter`)

Define role duties, decision authority, skills, and staffing capacity.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Activity RACI and escalation (`raci`)

Give each activity one accountable role, collaborators, and conflict escalation.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Pilot and transition gate (`pilot`)

Define pilot scope, resources, ten-week cadence, measures, and transition exits.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
